sources_used.source: Bing Maps (dentist / chiropractor / hair salon / nail salon / massage queries, New Brunswick center)

categories_thin: Nail salons - only about 4 in the New Brunswick core, though the town has many hair salons; specialty directors list just 3 and map searches mostly returned salons in North Brunswick/Somerset/Highland Park. Worth a phone-book or license-registry check.
Veterinary - only one animal hospital appears inside the town boundary (Paulus); most nearby vets are in North Brunswick/Highland Park.
Optometry - only two found (Weininger, Optical Boutique); likely more small practices that don't surface in directories that are reachable from here.
Med spas / aesthetics - just one clearly New Brunswick-based clinic; most competitors sit in North Brunswick/East Brunswick.

Mental health - group practices are few; the long tail here is solo licensed clinicians listed one-by-one on Psychology Today, which would be hundreds of individual practitioners rather than businesses, so they were not enumerated.
Gyms / fitness - the town's inventory is dominated by Rutgers recreation facilities and the RWJBarnabas wellness center, both excluded, leaving very few independent gyms.
caveats: Chains/franchises deliberately excluded even though they showed up repeatedly in searches: JAG Physical Therapy (77 Church St), Professional Physical Therapy (303 George St), SportsMed Physical Therapy (207 Livingston Ave), Great Expressions Dental Centers (716 Livingston Ave), Affordable Dentures Middlesex County (154 French St), Hand & Stone, Massage Envy, Aspen Dental.

Rutgers and RWJBarnabas entities excluded per the hospital/large-health-system and public-institution exclusions: Rutgers Health University Dental Associates (135 Somerset St), Rutgers Health Family Medicine at Monument Square (317 George St), Rutgers Health Department of Pediatrics (89 French St), RWJ Physical Therapy and RWJ Fitness & Wellness Center (100 Kirkpatrick St), Saint Peter's Family Health Center (123 How Lane), College Avenue Gym / Cook-Douglass Recreation Center / Rutgers Fitness Center.

Several entries come from map-derived bulk directories (BestProsInTown, HairSalonDirectories, NailSalonAtlas, HairBraidingAtlas) and are marked 'one directory listing' - these are small storefront salons whose only web presence is a Google Business Profile. Triage should confirm they are still trading.

Eric B. Chandler Health Center and Axis Family Care are included with flags: EBCHC is a federally qualified health center now branded under Rutgers Health; Axis operates under the Advocare network brand. Both may be caught by the health-system or brand-network exclusion on review.

True Cuts has two storefronts in the zone and is entered twice (College Ave and George St) with the shared brand website; Brunswick Health & Physical Therapy Center and 'Brunswick Health Center' at 151 Livingston Ave are merged into one entry.
No website was recorded unless it was opened or seen linked from a listing; many small salons have only a Google/Facebook presence, so blank website fields are expected rather than an error.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass API was unreachable from this environment (406 / timeouts), so no OSM cross-check was possible.

Yellow Pages, Manta, Superpages, Cylex, ChamberofCommerce.com, LocalityBiz and ShowMeLocal all returned 403 or JavaScript-only pages to direct fetching; Google Maps only rendered about 5 results per query in this browser profile, so full category sweeps via those sources were not possible.

The City of New Brunswick / New Brunswick City Center business directory (newbrunswick.com) could not be parsed - the listing index page failed to render, so the official downtown BID member list was not reviewed. Its directory would be the best remaining source for completeness.
No form of licensing registry (NJ Division of Consumer Affairs cosmetology/dental boards) was queried; that would confirm counts of licensed salons and dental offices by address.
Individual practitioner rosters (Psychology Today, Healthgrades, Zocdoc) list hundreds of solo clinicians by name; these were used to identify group practices only, not enumerated person by person.
Businesses in the Rutgers-adjacent student housing and hospital campus buildings may be missing because those addresses rarely appear in consumer directories.
